name: Frame Guard
description: Defends your frame rate in heavy levels: unlimited FPS toggle and a self-verifying batch draw fast path.

unlimited-fps.name: Unlimited FPS
unlimited-fps.description: Removes the FPS cap and turns VSync off. Off by default, so GD's own FPS limit applies. Turn it on if you want uncapped FPS (more CPU/GPU load and heat). After turning it off, restart the game to get VSync back.

fast-batch.name: Batch fast path (recommended)
fast-batch.description: Skips redundant per-frame work for sprites that did not change, which helps in levels with many objects. Safe to leave on: it checks itself while running and turns itself off for the session if the check fails. Does not change gameplay or physics.

vis-throttle-ms.name: [Experimental] Visibility throttle (ms)
vis-throttle-ms.description: Leave at 0 (off) unless you want to experiment. Above 0, the game updates which objects are visible less often to save time. Physics are not proven identical in every level, so do not use it for legit runs.

vis-camera-delta.name: Throttle camera limit (units)
vis-camera-delta.description: Only used when the visibility throttle above is greater than 0. If the camera jumps by this much, visibility updates immediately.

debug-log.name: Debug log (for bug reports)
debug-log.description: Writes FPS and performance info to the Geode log every 2 seconds. Leave off unless you are asked to send a log.
